faq.q: How do I install Honkai: Star Rail on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Honkai: Star Rail and check the developer is COGNOSPHERE PTE. LTD. before tapping Install. It needs Android 6.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from COGNOSPHERE PTE. LTD. and may be altered, so the safest way to play Honkai: Star Rail is the official listing.

Yes. Honkai: Star Rail is free to download and play, with no ads. In-app purchases from $0.29 to $99.99 per item on Google Play buy currency for Warps (its gacha banners) and passes. The story can be finished without paying.

faq.q: Is Honkai: Star Rail connected to Genshin Impact?
faq.a: No. Both are made by HoYoverse, but they're separate games with separate stories and accounts. Star Rail is set in the Honkai universe and uses turn-based combat instead of Genshin's real-time action.

faq.q: Why is Honkai: Star Rail rated Teen?
faq.a: Google Play rates it Teen for fantasy violence, simulated gambling and mild suggestive themes. The simulated gambling rating relates to its Warp gacha system and some in-game minigames.

faq.q: Can I play Honkai: Star Rail on PC too?
faq.a: Yes. Your HoYoverse account syncs progress between Android, iPhone, PC and PlayStation, so you can continue on another device.
